content: स {%ind.%} A prefix substituted for सह or सम्, सम, तुल्य, or सदृश and एक or समान, and compounded with nouns to form adjectives and adverbs in the sense of .³({%a%}) with, together with, along with, accompanied by, having, possessed of; सपुत्र, सभार्य, सतृष्ण, सधन, सरोषम्, सकोपम्, सहरि <ab>&c.</ab>; .³({%b%}) similar, like; सधर्मन् ‘of a similar nature’; so सजाति, सवर्ण; .³({%c%}) same; सोदर, सपक्ष, सपिण्ड, सनाभि <ab>&c.</ab> --{%m.%} .²1 A snake. .²2 Air, wind. .²3 A bird. .²4 Short name for the musical note षड्ज <ab>q. v.</ab> .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²6 Of Viṣṇu. .²7 (In prosody) A foot consisting of two short syllables followed by a long one. .²8 God; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .{@-सा@} The goddess Lakṣmī. .{@-सम्@} .²1 Knowledge. .²2 Meditation. .²3 A carriage-road. .²4 A fence, an enclosure.
